about: The answer key for the documents-link samples: the entries the two defining files hold, and for each mention on the station sheets the entry it refers to.
All text is invented. make-samples.mjs checks that every line_text is a line of its page and that line_text.slice(start, end) is the span.
page is 1-based. line_text is the line as pdftotext -bbox-layout reads it, its words joined by one space. start and end are JavaScript string offsets into line_text.
Identifiers match as the LBB link stage matches them: without whitespace, without case, and without a dot between leading letters and a digit (S 1.1, S1.1 and S.1.1 match).

A correct run makes every link whose refers_to is an entry, and no other link. A mention with refers_to null must not link; a run may list it as a mention or skip it. A span this key does not list (an area, a count, the running header or footer) must not link either.
accept_spans names other spans a run may report for the same mention (sec. 3.2 for 3.2). kind is the kind the LBB decision model should give the span.
notes: The key assumes the roles above. With the default role both, the station sheets define their station numbers (0.12, 0.14), and each defining line of the other two files is also a mention of its own entry (own_number). None of those mentions should link: no entry of another file describes the same item.

station-sheets.pdf repeats its header row (Example Plant, bottling line, station sheets), the rows Area Production hall and Item Parts, and a footer Page # of 2 on both pages. The LBB rows stage marks a row as running only when it repeats on more than max(2, 30% of the pages) pages, so on two pages these rows stay content. They hold no code.
service-manual.pdf defines the chapter 3 Maintenance above its sections. A run may list 3 as an entry (optional below); no mention refers to it.
